claim: The runtime registers and OpenAPI exposes GET /health/headers, but the agent-facing /context endpoint manifest omits this endpoint despite describing itself as a full endpoint manifest.
trigger: An agent discovers operations from /context and does not separately inspect OpenAPI.
impact: The header-diagnosis operation is callable but undiscoverable through the advertised machine manifest, so manifest-driven clients have incomplete service coverage.

evidence.detail: Sanitized ASGI smoke and route enumeration returned GET /health/headers with HTTP 200; generated OpenAPI contained /health/headers.
The same /context response returned 23 endpoint entries and none had path /health/headers.
src/main.py:568-586 defines @app.get('/health/headers'); src/main.py:1073-1077 describes /context as a full manifest for agents.

expected_behavior_source: The /context route description at src/main.py:1077 says it is the full endpoint manifest intended for agents; the OpenAPI operation and route decorator establish that /health/headers is a public operation.

runtime.command: env -i PATH="$PATH" PYTHONPATH="$PWD" PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX="$PWD/_review/runtime/routes-tmp/pycache" HOME="$PWD/_review/runtime/routes-tmp/home" HUB_STORAGE_TOKEN='[REDACTED]' HUB_STACK_URL='[REDACTED]' HUB_SECRET_KEY='[REDACTED]' HUB_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/_review/runtime/routes-tmp/cache" .venv/bin/python -I - <<'PY' ... enumerate app.routes, call /context and /openapi.json through httpx.ASGITransport ... PY
runtime.environment: env -i; inert dummy settings supplied for required HUB_* variables; no production credentials or network; bytecode/cache redirected below _review/runtime/routes-tmp
runtime.output_excerpt: Route enumeration included {"path":"/health/headers","methods":["GET"]}; ASGI GET /health/headers returned 200; OpenAPI path_count=19 included /health/headers; /context manifest_count=23 had no /health/headers entry.
runtime.expected: Every public endpoint represented by the full /context manifest, including GET /health/headers.
runtime.proves: Import and route registration succeeded; the runtime contract has a concrete advertised-manifest omission.

suggested_fix: Add GET /health/headers to the /context endpoints list and its endpoint-parity test, or narrow the manifest description and explicitly classify the diagnostic as intentionally omitted.

claim: The imported application advertises service version 0.2.0 while the checked-in pyproject package contract is version 0.2.1, because stale tracked egg-info metadata takes precedence at import time.
trigger: Running the application from this checkout while the tracked kbc_artifact_hub.egg-info metadata has not been regenerated.
impact: /health, /context, landing-page version output, and OpenAPI info report 0.2.0 for a checkout whose package descriptor declares 0.2.1, confusing release identification and client diagnostics.

evidence.detail: Sanitized import check printed service_version=0.2.0, metadata_version=0.2.0, pyproject_version=0.2.1.
src/main.py:111-117 explicitly prefers importlib.metadata package metadata before parsing pyproject.toml.
pyproject.toml:3 declares version 0.2.1; kbc_artifact_hub.egg-info/PKG-INFO:3 declares tracked metadata version 0.2.0.

expected_behavior_source: src/main.py:109 calls this value the single source of truth for service version; pyproject.toml:3 is the checked-in package version contract.

runtime.command: env -i PATH="$PATH" PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX="$PWD/_review/runtime/routes-tmp/pycache-version" HUB_STORAGE_TOKEN='[REDACTED]' HUB_STACK_URL='[REDACTED]' HUB_SECRET_KEY='[REDACTED]' HUB_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/_review/runtime/routes-tmp/version-cache" .venv/bin/python -I - <<'PY' ... import src.main, importlib.metadata, tomllib; print service, metadata, and pyproject versions ... PY
runtime.environment: env -i; inert dummy settings supplied for required HUB_* variables; no production credentials or network; bytecode/cache redirected below _review/runtime/routes-tmp
runtime.expected: The running service version should match the checked-in package descriptor (0.2.1), or the source checkout should not prefer stale metadata over pyproject.toml.
runtime.proves: Import succeeds but selects stale package metadata and publishes a version inconsistent with the checked-in release descriptor.

suggested_fix: Regenerate/remove stale tracked egg-info during packaging, or validate metadata against pyproject.toml and fall back or fail on a mismatch.
